headline: Executive order directs federal agencies to address environmental and health harms affecting minority and low-income communities.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order tells federal agencies to consider how their actions affect the environment and health of minority and low-income communities. It makes addressing these effects, often called environmental justice, part of how agencies carry out their work. No summary was provided, so the specific requirements are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: Federal agencies are directed to consider and address environmental effects of their actions on these communities.
Federal agencies are directed to consider and address environmental effects of their actions on these communities.
Agencies are given new responsibilities to address environmental justice in their programs and decisions.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed February 11, 1994; the exact effective date is not stated in the provided material.
